skills.name: Offer up your heart
skills.description: Right hand to chest for courage. Gives good effects to allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (3 sec) *HP +300% (7 sec)

skills.name: I'll destroy them!
skills.description: Transforms into a Titan and attacks. Gives bad effects to enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *ATK x 3000% Area Damage  *Stuns enemies (4 sec) *Switches places with enemies

abilities.name: Group: Attack on Titan
abilities.description: Attack on Titan Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Same Fate
abilities.description: When the Ranger is defeated, it will randomly take 1 of the enemies with it. It has a certain chance of activating in PVP and Guild War, and a lower chance in other battles. (Bosses and Guardians will not be affected by this Ability)
